title: ReuseDecisionRecord v1
description: C3 primary scientific artifact. One record per evaluation of the cross-context reuse and capability-gap decision procedure. Encodes the five ordered gates of proposal section 3.5 (p.18), the four reuse-eligibility outcomes, the frozen context-distance ladder of Figure 13, the requirement that every output names the rule and the context dimension that produced it, the per-use outcome receipt, and the replication guard on a transferable-capability-gap claim. System-independent: it refers to a governed-judgment record by identifier and hash and does not restate C2-owned record content.
$comment: Obligations this schema cannot express and that a companion validator must enforce: (1) decision.contextDimensionId must equal the contextDimensionId of the gateEvaluations entry named by decision.gateId; (2) capabilityGapAssertion.replications must be pairwise distinct on contextSha256; (3) contextDistance entries must be derivable from sourceContext.dimensionValues and targetContext.dimensionValues; (4) contextDistanceSchema.sha256 must match the frozen ladder document on disk; (5) outcomeReceipt.decisionRecordSha256 must match the canonicalized record with outcomeReceipt removed.

allOf.$comment: G1 fails or is undetermined: no restricted evidence may have been exposed, and no later gate runs. Proposal p.18: the procedure evaluates visibility and authorization before exposing restricted evidence.
Outcome Eligible: all five gates pass without adaptation; no adaptation object; no independent-review routing.
Outcome Eligible with adaptation: no gate fails or is undetermined, at least one gate returns pass_with_adaptation, and the named adaptation is recorded.
Outcome Blocked: exactly one gate carries the failure, the prior judgment is withheld, and no adaptation is recorded.

Outcome Undetermined: distinct from both allow and block. Exactly one gate is undetermined, the record has no reuse effect, and it must route to independent review. Proposal p.18: missing or conflicting evidence is treated neither as safe reuse nor as permanent prohibition.
Read-side currency gate. A source judgment that is not active at the moment of use may not yield an eligible outcome. Lifecycle state is owned by the C2 contract; C3 owns only this read.
Unknown lifecycle state is missing evidence, which is Undetermined rather than either allow or block.
exceedsCohort is the frozen above-cohort threshold, not a free judgment: it is true exactly when the highest differing dimension outranks cohort (rank 2).

Replication guard. A declared transferable capability gap requires a predeclared failure signature, at least two distinct frozen replication contexts of which at least one differs above cohort, independent confirmation, and all five alternative causes ruled out. Proposal p.18.
An unapproved procedure version cannot produce an admissible study result.
Any gate that changes the outcome must name the context dimension that produced it.
A gate that never ran carries no timestamp and no evidence.
